transport: RS-485 RJ-45 (jacks "COMM 1" / "COMM 2") · Modbus RTU · 9600 8N1 · slave ID = "COMM ID" parameter, range 1-255, default 1
blocks: NO REGISTER MAP IS OBTAINABLE FROM ANY PUBLIC SOURCE. Samlex holds the EVO "Modbus Communication Protocol Guide" under NDA and releases it only to individuals who contact tech support (604-525-3836 / techsupport@samlexamerica.com) and sign one. The single community implementation that exists (logicminds/dbus-serialinverter) is architected specifically to keep the addresses out of git: config.ini ships every register as the literal string '???' and the real values live in a git-ignored config.ini.private. So the driver cost here is not a bench day, it is a phone call plus a legal review of whether an NDA-derived map can live in this repo at all. Nothing can be written until that is resolved.
refutedOnReview: REFUTED. The sources exist and the claim quotes them honestly, but they do not support grouping eight models into one register map — and by the catalogue's own non-negotiable rule ("a model joins an existing dialect ONLY when a source shows matching register addresses"), zero of the eight qualify.  WHAT I VERIFIED (all files present, text extracted with pdftotext -layout):  1. /Users/lemarier/dev/solar/docs/samlex-ev
gotchas: REGISTER ADDRESSES: none. Absent, not guessed. vendor-doc that Modbus exists; nothing at any confidence for what is in it.

Slave ID default 1 is vendor-doc: EVO-RC-PLUS manual §4.8.2.6 states 'Parameter COMM ID (Communication ID) sets the ID number for the COMM Port and EVO-RC-PLUS Remote Control', and Table 6.6 in the EVO owner's manuals gives range 1-255, default 1. Note this one parameter addresses BOTH the Modbus COMM port and the remo

9600 8N1 is community-single. Only logicminds/dbus-serialinverter states it (0 stars, last pushed 2026-03-30). No Samlex document reviewed here states a baud rate. A GitHub code search for a second independent Samlex Modbus implementation returned nothing. Do not treat as crosschecked.

CONTRADICTION — state of charge: dbus-serialinverter defines REG_SOC 'uint16, state of charge 0-100 %' and publishes /Soc. But NO Samlex data-logging field list, for any EVO model, includes state of charge; the vendor logs battery volt and battery current only. Either the register exists and Samlex simply does not log
COMM 3 / COMM 4 are also RJ-45 and are labelled 'For CANbus Serial Communication Protocol (for future use)' in the fw 0.82 manual. Not a CAN BMS port. Do not plug a battery into them.
unmappedReports: AC INPUT side entirely — the vendor logs 'Grid volt', 'Grid freq', 'Input current', 'Input VA', 'Input watt', 'Gen volt', 'Gen freq' alongside the output values. MetricKind's ac-voltage / ac-current / ac-power / ac-frequency are single-sided and cannot carry input and output simultaneously. Every multi-mode inverter/charger in the catalogue hits this; it is the largest contract gap Samlex exposes., 'Grid status' and 'Gen status' — AC-source present-and-within-limits flags. Not generator-run-state, which is about an engine; these are about whether the EVO will accept transfer., 'External current' — DC amps on the External Charger / DC I/O studs, a second DC path distinct from the battery. No MetricKind for a secondary DC branch., 'Transformer temperature', 'Busbar temperature', 'Heat sink temperature' — device-internal thermals. MetricKind has battery-temperature and temperature (ambient); neither means 'this component inside the box'., 'Fan speed', 'Mode' — operating mode enum (0=Power Save, 1=AC Normal, 2=AC Abnormal, 3=Inverting, 4=Fault). charge-stage covers only the charging half; there is no MetricKind for inverter operating mode., 'Error code' — numeric fault code. No MetricKind carries a device fault code, only clear-fault exists on the command side., 'Event' — discrete event log entries.
